adaptations.localChanges: Adapt native alert markup into a stateless HEEX API with explicit announcement semantics and caller-owned lifecycle.
Adapt avatar presentation into an initials-first HEEX fallback with caller-owned image loading.
Adapt passive badge variants into a closed noninteractive HEEX component contract.
Adapt button utility patterns to native HEEX button semantics, closed variants, and caller-owned activation.
Adapt card markup into composable semantic HEEX regions without assigning workflow behavior.
Adapt skeleton presentation into a decorative HEEX placeholder with a reduced-motion-safe snapshot.
Adapt native label presentation into a protected HEEX relationship primitive with explicit required and optional indicators.
Compose upstream-informed form presentation into a deterministic relationship-aware HEEX field boundary.
Extract visible descriptive form text into an escaped deterministic HEEX relationship fragment.
Render caller-owned validation messages as ordered escaped content with deterministic IDs and no live-region policy.
Compose caller-owned form errors into an ordinary linked summary without package-owned focus or announcement behavior.
Adapt native input presentation into a closed HEEX text-entry API with shared FormField relationships and caller-owned lifecycle.
Adapt native checkbox presentation into explicit boolean and repeated-value HEEX modes with deterministic field relationships.
Adapt native radio-group presentation into a validated HEEX fieldset with deterministic option identity and caller-owned selection.
Adapt switch track-and-thumb presentation onto the native boolean Checkbox HEEX contract without adding a second state model.
Adapt native select presentation into validated HEEX option and optgroup data with deterministic field relationships and ordinary browser submission.
Adapt the standards-based customizable-select structure and presentation into a capability-gated HEEX API over the exact visible native fallback.
Adapt native textarea presentation into a relationship-aware HEEX API with closed resize policy and progressive CSS content sizing.
Adapt slider presentation onto one native range input with deterministic field relationships and caller-owned value display.
Adapt task-progress presentation onto the native progress element with explicit naming, validated bounds, and caller-owned lifecycle.
Separate scalar measurement into a native meter API with validated threshold attributes and browser-owned zone semantics.
Namespace semantic tokens, prefix generated utilities, remove Preflight, add sRGB fallback, and scope theme and reduced-motion behavior.
